label: rs-c20-n3
_why: THE CANON AT A STEEPER COST SLOPE (user, 2026-10-12: "Raise to 2.0, raise AI-values on higher tiers slightly over-proportionally to compensate, run n=3"). Book config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-c20.json = the canon jex-dam4s-rs regenerated through its own recorded chain (proven to reproduce the canon field for field at C 1.9) with --cost-ratio 2.0 in place of 1.9 and --ai-ladder 1000,1000,3200,5600 in place of 1000,1000,3000,5000. Field diff against the canon: building_cost and ai_value only, on 68 leaves — e2 cost +5.3% / desire +6.7%, e3 cost +10.8% / desire +12%, the merge hosts at their geometric midpoints, the e0 factories 5% CHEAPER (their cost follows the e1 anchor down by 1/C); the crafts (fixed), the recipes, technologies, research and dams unchanged. Motivation: the canon's n=3 (F227) has one runoff seed in three and over-depeasanted leaders (Britain 0.5-2.3% U* in two seeds); new tiered capital pays back in 6.4-7.1 years at realised prices and wages (vanilla manufacturing 6.9-7.2), the frontier faster (e3 4.3-5.6, e2 6.0), and the cost slope is the lever that lowers the hoard and W together (F135).

_arms.c20: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-c20.json} (+ its tree twin, the canon's byte for byte).

_comparison: the canon jex-dam4s-rs (20261012_203800_jex-dam4s-rs-stitched-n3, F227) for the change; vanilla n=16 (20260821_131149) for the register.

_predictions.GDP: world GDP end state a little below the canon's 1.04 / 1.09 / 1.45 — the runoff seed less likely; the mid-game (1905) dip slightly deeper
_predictions.labour: the shortlist's W a little lower than 0.82 and U* a little higher than 28.6%; Britain's U* above the canon's 0.5-2.3% in more seeds
_predictions.capital: new e2/e3 capital paying back in ~6.3-6.8 years once the loop settles (not the full cost rise: scarcer frontier means higher prices); the hoard as the canon's or lower
_predictions.rungs: e0 factories marginally more attractive (5% cheaper, desire unchanged); T0 at or slightly above the canon's
_predictions.tech: unchanged within seed spread (research does not read building cost)

_stop_rule: none: a fixed n=3 (the user's instruction), every run plays to 1936; the stop watcher is NOT armed.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Do NOT edit the emitters, the generators or the book while it runs.
